description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 (P2) — `SELECT users . * FROM users` (whitespace around the dot) is a star projection. The extractor does not resolve it, so the row is tagged strip-all (fail closed) and the client receives an empty object — never the protected column.
rationale: §14.8.9: "A query whose origins cannot be resolved still degrades to the wholesale strip, never to 'no protected column'." Before S443 round 6 the spaced star fell to an opaque entry naming no protected identifier and the route served the full row, passwordHash included (measured over HTTP).
